name: Name
description: Represents a defined name for a range of cells. Names can be either built-in names-such as Database, Print_Area, and Auto_Open-or custom names.
remarks: The Name object is a member of the Names collection for the Application, Workbook, and Worksheet objects. Use Names (_index_), where _index_ is the name index number or defined name, to return a single Name object. The index number indicates the position of the name within the collection. Names are placed in alphabetic order, from a to z, and are not case-sensitive. Although a Range object can have more than one name, there's no Names collection for the Range object. Use Name with a Range object to return the first name from the list of names (sorted alphabetically) assigned to the range.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Returns or sets the category for the specified name in the language of the macro. The name must refer to a custom function or command. Read/write String.

properties.name: CategoryLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the category for the specified name, in the language of the user, if the name refers to a custom function or command. Read/write String.

properties.name: MacroType
properties.description: Returns or sets what the name refers to. Read/write XlXLMMacroType.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: RefersTo
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula that the name is defined to refer to, in the language of the macro and in A1-style notation, beginning with an equal sign. Read/write String.

properties.name: ShortcutKey
properties.description: Returns or sets the shortcut key for a name defined as a custom Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro command. Read/write String.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the formula that the name is defined to refer to.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: NameLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the object, in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: RefersToLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula that the name refers to. The formula is in the language of the user, and it's in A1-style notation, beginning with an equal sign. Read/write String.

properties.name: RefersToR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula that the name refers to. The formula is in the language of the macro, and it's in R1C1-style notation, beginning with an equal sign. Read/write String.

properties.name: RefersToR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula that the name refers to. This formula is in the language of the user, and it's in R1C1-style notation, beginning with an equal sign. Read/write String.

properties.name: RefersToRange
properties.description: Returns the Range object referred to by a Name object. Read-only.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Returns or sets the comment associated with the name. Read/write String.

properties.name: WorkbookParameter
properties.description: Returns or sets the specified Name object as a workbook parameter. Read/write.

properties.name: ValidWorkbookParameter
properties.description: Returns True if the specified Name object is a valid workbook parameter. Read-only Boolean.
